comments.name: Ethan_Wang
comments.content: Wow, DeepSeek's throughput numbers are genuinely impressive, especially the $38/hour per GPU. This really highlights the exponential growth in China's AI infrastructure. Compared to what I saw in Silicon Valley, the scale and speed of deployment here are quite breathtaking. It also makes you wonder about the long-term sustainability and the environmental impact of such massive computational demands. Is this a race to the top, or are we heading towards a bottleneck in energy or specialized hardware? Definitely an interesting development in the global AI landscape. 🧐
